case.title: Yarn
case.request: Make a useful crochet piece with the photographed yarn and tools, with consistent counts and complete steps.

design.purpose: A useful two-tone chunky storage basket for one adult to hold yarn, remotes or toiletries. It uses part of each photographed ball; stop and check remaining yarn before Round 12 and omit that round if less than about 3 m of blue remains.

steps.c: Place the green yarn on the work surface
Place the blue yarn beside the green yarn
Place the 15 mm hook ready for use
Green: magic ring, 6 sc into ring, join
Green: 2 sc in each stitch, 12 sc, join
Green: repeat sc, 2 sc in next, 18 sc
Green: repeat 2 sc, 2 sc in next, 24 sc
Green: repeat 3 sc, 2 sc in next, 30 sc
Change to blue; sc in back loop only, 30 sc
Blue: sc in each stitch, 30 sc, join
Blue: sc in each stitch, 30 sc, join
Blue: sc in each stitch, 30 sc, join
Blue: sc in each stitch, 30 sc, join
Blue: sc in each stitch, 30 sc, join
Blue: sc in each stitch, 30 sc, slip stitch, fasten off
Cut the blue yarn leaving a 15 cm tail
Cut the green yarn leaving a 15 cm tail
Use the hook to weave both tails through stitches
Trim woven tails flush with the scissors
Turn the basket right side out and shape the walls
